readability_improvements.benefit: Clarifies the table's purpose as a cache of distinct words and their sorted letter signatures.
Replaces single-letter abbreviation with explicit semantic description.
Distinguishes the tail string from the isolated character during character splitting.
Directly conveys which signature corresponds to the subject vs candidate.
Clearly explains why subject_sorted = candidate_sorted AND LOWER(subject) <> LOWER(candidate) is required.
